decisions.reason: The conferencing service has become commoditized by major collaboration platforms and no longer aligns with the firm's core connectivity strategy.
Metro data centre connectivity remains a core, high-demand offering that leverages the firm's owned fibre and data centre strengths.
Optical spectrum connectivity is central to high-bandwidth, software-defined infrastructure and supports customer cloud adoption.
The voice number ordering portal still delivers operational efficiency and digital self-service for existing voice customers.
Direct voice network connections face structural decline as enterprises migrate to IP-based and cloud communications, making it non-strategic.
